notes.subject: moya
notes.rationale: נפשí gape mo — mafahla ya maphelo, e sego רוח

notes.subject: o theoga
notes.rationale: דלפה — go theoga bjalo ka mekgwa ya metsinkwana, seswantšho sa dikgoadi; e gatelelwa ke 'go phaphoma'

notes.subject: neme
notes.rationale: קימני: 'neme' (go emisa, go tiisa) kgahlanong le 'ntišetša maoto' (go hlaba) — dikgatiso di fapana (KJV 'strengthen', JPS 'sustain')

notes.subject: go Yahwe
notes.rationale: Poko ye e lebišitšwe go Elohim

translation: Moya wa ka o theoga ka dikgoadi tše di boima; neme go ya ka lentšu la gago.

tokens.gloss: go ya ka lentšu la gago
